newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 12 killed in Kashmir blasts - police.
newsitem.headline: At least 12 killed in Kashmir blasts - police.

text.p: At least 12 people died and 50 were injured on Saturday when two bombs exploded at the central bus station in this city in India's Jammu and Kashmir state, police said.
Police told Reuters several women and children were among the injured and 16 people were in serious condition.

Eight people in a tourist bus waiting to depart died instantly in the first blast and eight more succumbed to their injuries as they were being taken to hospital, eyewitnesses said. The tourist bus was gutted and two others parked nearby were badly damaged by a second blast a few minutes later.
Most of the injured were taken to the Government Medical College in the city, the winter capital of Jammu and Kashmir state.
The witnesses said an angry crowd gathered at the bus station and hurled stones at policy and emergency workers who rushed to the scene.
